description: This file contains unit tests for the class ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl, which is part of a command implementation in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing the behavior of modifying feature properties in a live command context.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl, verifying immutability, equality, null handling, property accessors, and toString implementation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, creating a twinCommand and an instance of ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl is immutable and that JsonPointer and JsonValue used within are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that the equals and hashCode methods work correctly for the class, applying EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToGetModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandForNull
methods.description: Tests that passing null to the factory method throws a NullPointerException with the appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToGetModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandForCreateThingCommand
methods.description: Ensures that passing a command of an incompatible type throws a ClassCastException.

methods.name: getModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the getters on the created live command return expected values based on the twinCommand.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that setting new DittoHeaders returns a command with the updated headers.

methods.name: answerReturnsNotNull
methods.description: Ensures that the answer() method of the command returns a non-null result.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toString() method outputs a string containing the class name and key command details.
